title: Inclusive Innovation: Integrating Equity-Based Design Thinking in Science and Engineering
description:
Innovative teams need diverse perspectives to design meaningful solutions. Without them, blind spots and bias can limit creativity and impact.
Up4 The Challenge is hosting a hands-on design sprint that applies equity-based principles to explore how identity, values, and social context shape design outcomes. Participants will gain practical tools to apply co-design approaches directly to their current projects, generating more inclusive and impactful solutions.

participants.title: Co-Founder @ Up4 The Challenge; Adjunct Assistant Professor @ Queen's and McMaster Universities
